'use strict';
const DATA=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('data').textContent);const mons=DATA.mons, trainers=DATA.trainers;
const COLORS={'Normal':'#adb4bf','Fire':'#f59b5b','Water':'#73b7f8','Electric':'#f9cf65','Grass':'#8dda96','Ice':'#92d3db','Fighting':'#ee9590','Poison':'#c8a1fa','Ground':'#d7b687','Flying':'#b7bcef','Psychic':'#ef99b9','Bug':'#a5d276','Rock':'#c6b897','Ghost':'#baaceb','Dragon':'#8895ee','Dark':'#a2a6b7','Steel':'#a5c4d0','Fairy':'#efb7ed'};
let tab='pokemon', query='', type='', sort='dex', openId=null;
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const chip=t=>`<span class="chip" style="background:${COLORS[t]||'#bbc3d6'}">${esc(t)}</span>`;
const img=(obj,what)=>{const p=(typeof obj==='object'&&obj!==null)?obj:{image:obj}; const src=(p.embeddedFromCurrentPRU&&p.image)?p.image:(p.battleSprite||p.image||''); const fallback=p.image||''; return src?`<img class="sprite" loading="lazy" alt="${esc(what)} sprite" src="${esc(src)}" data-fallback="${esc(fallback)}" onerror="if(this.dataset.fallback&&this.src!==this.dataset.fallback){this.src=this.dataset.fallback;this.onerror=null}else{this.style.display='none'}">`:'<div class="missing">PRU source sprite pending</div>'};
const types=[...new Set(mons.flatMap(x=>x.types))].sort();document.getElementById('type').innerHTML+=[...types].map(t=>`<option value="${esc(t)}">${esc(t)}</option>`).join('');
const grid=document.getElementById('grid'); const summary=document.getElementById('summary');
function render(){
 document.getElementById('search').style.display=tab==='pokemon'?'':'none';document.getElementById('type').style.display=tab==='pokemon'?'':'none';document.getElementById('sort').style.display=tab==='pokemon'?'':'none';
 document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===tab));
 if(tab==='pokemon'){
  let arr=mons.filter(m=>(!type||m.types.includes(type))&&(!query||m.name.toLowerCase().includes(query)||String(m.id).includes(query)||m.abilities.toLowerCase().includes(query)));
  if(sort==='name')arr.sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name));if(sort==='bst')arr.sort((a,b)=>b.bst-a.bst||a.id-b.id);
  summary.textContent=`${arr.length} of ${mons.length} Pokémon · ${mons.filter(x=>x.battleSprite).length} current battle-front source links · tap a Pokémon for stats & moves · Unown #245 includes 29 forms`;
  grid.className='grid'; grid.innerHTML=arr.map(m=>`<button class="pokemon" data-id="${m.id}" aria-label="Open ${esc(m.name)} details"><span class="dexno">#${String(m.id).padStart(3,'0')}</span><div class="sprite-frame">${img(m,m.name)}</div><div class="monname">${esc(m.name)}</div><div class="typebar">${m.types.map(chip).join('')}</div></button>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">No Pokémon match your search.</div>';
 }else if(tab==='trainers'){
 summary.textContent=`${trainers.length} provisional trainer portraits embedded · artwork is not automatically approved for the ROM`;
 grid.className='grid trainergrid';grid.innerHTML=trainers.map((t,i)=>`<button class="pokemon trainer-card" data-trainer="${i}"><div class="sprite-frame">${img(t,t.name)}</div><div class="monname">${esc(t.name)}</div><div class="tiny">${esc(t.role||t.region)}</div></button>`).join('');
 }else{
 summary.textContent='Artwork and data provenance';grid.className='about';grid.innerHTML=`<img class=\"pru-logo-img\" alt=\"Official PRU logo\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,
